risks.title: Uncertain ACL estimates
risks.score_rationale: ACL estimation is described as the most critical and complex accounting estimate, with direct impact on financial results. Language emphasizes significant uncertainties tied to economic forecasts and management judgment. 3.7% sensitivity upside under recession scenario shows substantive risk. Capital category is heavily weighted in financial sector.

risks.title: Credit quality deterioration
risks.score_rationale: Net credit losses charged increased to 1.32% of average loans, and NPL ratio climbed to 1.59%, up sequentially. Document mentions $5.1M specific reserve for telecommunications commercial loan, indicating heightened sectoral default risk.

risks.title: Dependence on Puerto Rico economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: While Puerto Rico economy is stable, company actively monitors global uncertainties impacting the island. Dependence on reconstruction funds and private investments creates vulnerability to external shocks. Risk is repeated across recent developments, confirming its importance.

risks.title: Macroeconomic forecast volatility
risks.score_rationale: ACL methodology relies on macroeconomic scenarios (baseline and recession) with subjective weightings. Variation in these assumptions has direct impact on provision. Recession scenario being more heavily weighted for U.S. loans shows growing concern.

risks.title: Capital management risks
risks.score_rationale: OFG launched multiple share repurchase programs and increased dividends, which could limit financial flexibility under economic stress. CET1 ratio declined slightly to 13.97%, though remains solid. Risk is moderate but monitored.

risks.title: Accelerated technology asset depreciation
risks.score_rationale: $6.1M charge for accelerated technology asset depreciation recorded, tied to strategic or contractual changes. Reflects obsolescence or technology reorganization risk, but no major operational impact reported.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in the report.
